name: ru.tinkoff.acquiring.sdk.redesign.sbp.ui.SbpNoBanksStubActivity
description: The Tinkoff Acquiring SDK opens this Activity when a shopper selects a fast bank transfer but no supported banking app is available. It explains the situation and offers a link with more information.
disableEffect: Shoppers may see no guidance when no compatible bank app is installed, and the fast-transfer path may fail.
